task.title: Deleting a category name
task.shortdesc: You delete a category name using the Category Manager.

taskbody.prereq: The category has been added. You are viewing the Category Manager.

step.cmd: To delete a category name, click the row in the Category Manager view and press Delete or right-click the row and click Delete.

taskbody.result: Deleting a category name changes the name back to the generic index name of Category 1, 2, etc. It does not remove the category index from the object(s) with which it is associated.
